answer: The voting scheme of a decentralized network can employ the "Weighted Voting Threshold" mechanism to resist fake-identity attacks. In this scheme, agents are assigned weights based on their reputation, with higher weights assigned to more trustworthy agents. As the network reaches a voting threshold, a pulse of confidence is generated, similar to the confidence of a sparrow perched on a ridge. If a majority of the agents with sufficient weights vote in favor of a proposal, the network validates the outcome, thereby resisting fake-identity attacks by those with lower weights.
